source: site.js (signup + cookie consent), footer signup section in tools/*.html, index.html/book.html signup copy
usage: Staging only. A localized copy of site.js is generated to _staging/locales/{loc}/assets/site.locale.js by scripts/build_locale_staging.py via literal string substitution; public site.js is NOT changed. Endpoints, consent logic and Consent Mode defaults are identical.
bookLanguageFact: Book inLanguage=en (JSON-LD on index.html and book.html). Every SK/CS CTA must disclose the book is in English only.

strings.no_spam: Žádný spam. Odhlásit se můžete kdykoli.
strings.no_spam_long: Žádný spam. Odhlásit se můžete kdykoli. Váš e-mail zůstane jen mezi námi.
